problem: RSH-531 requires mapping NetSuite verification tools. The helix-cli repo provides the CLI infrastructure for runtime inspection (hlx inspect), skill bundling (hlx skill), and contains the comprehensive verification architecture design document from a prior implementation ticket.

files.why: CLI entry point. Defines hlx inspect repos/db/logs/api commands for runtime inspection, and hlx skill show/install for agent skill management.
Runtime inspection command implementations: database queries, log searches, API calls -- the 3 runtime inspection types available for NS verification.
Agent skill bundling. The CLI bundles a SKILL.md that provides canonical guidance to the agent during workflow steps.
CLI documentation including authentication setup, all commands, and troubleshooting.

Comprehensive verification architecture design (1300+ lines). Section 4.5 defines NS-specific verification: SuiteQL queries, script deployment XML checks, log checks, API calls (RESTlet/SuiteTalk), workflow state transitions. Defines 4-outcome model and Sandwich Model verification cascade.

facts: hlx inspect db --repo <name> '<sql>' provides read-only database queries for runtime inspection.
hlx inspect logs --repo <name> '<query>' provides log searching capabilities.
hlx inspect api --repo <name> <path> provides API endpoint inspection.
The CLI bundles agent skills via hlx skill show/install for Claude Code or Codex agent directories.

The verification architecture design (cmpd9loth00cnfw0uu5pja25s ticket) defines NS-specific verification methods at Section 4.5: SuiteQL queries, script deployment verification (check deployment XML), log checks (verify execution logs), API calls (RESTlet/SuiteTalk endpoints), workflow verification (workflow state transitions).
The design identifies 5 NS verification tools: SuiteQL, script deployment XML inspection, execution logs, RESTlet/SuiteTalk API calls, and workflow state verification.
Production data from the design ticket shows 1,200 total completed runs with 63.1% SUCCEEDED, 22.3% FAILED, 11.6% UNVERIFIED. 89.9% of UNVERIFIED are verification_broken with zero retries.
Tooling/browser failures account for 28.9% of all failures -- agent-browser CLI, curl, simplified flows are listed as resolution strategies.
unknowns: Whether the CLI inspection commands (hlx inspect) are used during the NS verification step or only during scout/diagnosis.
Whether additional CLI commands for NS-specific verification would be needed beyond the existing inspect db/logs/api.
